//: Type-checking config for the CLI core under src/. The base tsconfig.json is tuned for how the bridge/SDK is bundled, not for whole-tree checking, so this layers the checker settings on top: emit nothing, keep strict OFF for now (the codebase has never been type-checked and turning strict on at the same time as introducing the check would bury the real signal), and check every .ts/.tsx under src/. Run it with `bun run typecheck`. The error count it produces is ratcheted by scripts/pr/typecheck-baseline.json — see scripts/pr/typecheck-ratchet.ts.
